children: Paraguay’s Producer Price Index fell 1.7% year over year in August 2025, following a 1.5% decline in July and marking its seventh consecutive annual decrease.
By product grouping, both domestic and imported products made negative contributions to the overall result.

The decline was mainly driven by negative contributions from domestic agriculture and horticultural products, as well as imported metallic products, machinery and equipment, and food, beverages and tobacco, textiles, and leather products.
Other sections, particularly domestic non-metallic transportable goods and other manufactured products, helped mitigate the decline.
The PPI was unchanged on a monthly basis, while the cumulative change in the first eight months of the year stood at -0.7%.

title: Paraguay Producer Prices Extend Decline
